title: Scars in random waves and the FGF 1/2 universality class
summary: We study the large-domain asymptotics of geometric observables in Berry's random wave model on $\mathbb{R}^d$. We show that, in sharp contrast with the behavior of stationary random fields with absolutely continuous spectral measures, any observable whose fluctuations are asymptotically fully correlated with its second Wiener chaos projection belongs to a common universality class governed by a fractional Gaussian field with Hurst index $H=(1-d)/2$.
